summary: Web agents that act from rendered pixels avoid the fragility and heavy token cost of reading a page's HTML or accessibility tree, but training them depends on large amounts of high-quality interaction trajectories, and how to produce such data at scale remains an open problem. Public datasets typically contain only a few thousand trajectories drawn from a fixed and narrow set of websites, and even recent automated synthesis pipelines stay bound to predefined site lists or tutorial sources, so the number of distinct websites the agent ever sees barely grows. We present BrowserForge, a framework that generates web interaction data at scale by driving many browser sandboxes in parallel over the open web. BrowserForge couples three components: an open-web sourcing stage that exposes the agent to hundreds of thousands of real, openly reachable websites; a sandbox cluster manager that schedules hundreds of concurrent browsers with high utilization; and a Proposer-Solver dual-agent loop that turns a raw page into an executable task and then collects a verified trajectory for it. A rule-plus-model cleaning pipeline removes failed runs and rewrites the surviving reasoning into a single unified chain-of-thought style. Page structure such as the accessibility tree is used only as a synthesis-time signal; the agent we train and release acts purely from the screenshot. The resulting corpus contains 203,238 trajectories, each collected from a distinct website, larger and more diverse than prior trajectory datasets. Fine-tuning a compact multimodal model on this corpus raises its success rate on the live Online-Mind2Web from 25.66% to 33.33% and consistently improves step accuracy on the static Multimodal-Mind2Web, with the gain growing as the corpus scales. Controlled analyses further confirm that open-web sourcing and broad website coverage are key contributors to the observed improvement.
title: BrowserForge: Scaling Web Episode via Parallel Browser Sandboxes
title_translated: BrowserForge：通过并行浏览器沙箱实现网页交互轨迹的规模化生成
summary_translated: 从渲染像素中执行动作的网络智能体避免了读取页面HTML或可访问性树所带来的脆弱性和高昂的token成本，但其训练依赖于大量高质量的交互轨迹数据，而如何大规模生成此类数据仍是未解难题。公开数据集通常仅包含来自固定且狭窄网站集合的数千条轨迹，即使最近的自动化合成管道也受限于预定义的网站列表或教程来源，导致智能体所见的独立网站数量几乎无法增长。我们提出BrowserForge框架，通过在开放网络上并行驱动多个浏览器沙箱，实现网页交互数据的大规模生成。BrowserForge结合三个组件：一个开放网络数据源阶段，使智能体接触到数十万真实可访问的网站；一个沙箱集群管理器，高效调度数百个并发浏览器；以及一个提议-求解双智能体循环，将原始页面转化为可执行任务并收集经验证的轨迹。一个基于规则与模型的清洗流程剔除失败运行，并将剩余推理过程统一为单一的思维链风格。页面结构（如可访问性树）仅作为合成阶段的信号使用；我们训练并发布的智能体完全基于截图进行操作。最终生成的数据集包含203,238条轨迹，每条均来自不同网站，规模和多样性均超过以往轨迹数据集。在此数据集上微调一个紧凑的多模态模型，使其在Live Online-Mind2Web上的成功率从25.66%提升至33.33%，并在静态Multimodal-Mind2Web上持续提高步骤准确率，且随着数据集规模扩大，性能增益愈加显著。受控分析进一步证实，开放网络数据获取和广泛的网站覆盖是性能提升的关键因素。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as AI analysts to process financial disclosures and support AI-assisted investment decisions. Yet such systems are usually evaluated by what they can retrieve, not whether retrieved information affects their judgments. We identify a retrieval-integration gap in long-context financial analysis. Holding focal-firm information fixed and varying only unrelated context from 2,000 to 128,000 tokens, we find that a risk disclosure's influence on investment judgments falls to the experimental noise floor even as direct retrieval remains accurate. The pattern replicates across model families and judgment tasks and in experiments removing real disclosures from actual 10-K filings. More capable models postpone but do not eliminate the gap. Causal memory interventions show that compressed summaries and source-text lookup jointly transmit disclosures into judgments. Workflow architecture determines whether this transmission succeeds: chunk-and-summarize pipelines evict relevant information, whereas a targeted, structured restatement adjacent to the decision restores its influence. AI analyst performance is therefore jointly determined by model capability and workflow architecture. Retrieval-based evaluations can certify systems whose investment judgments ignore information they demonstrably retrieved.
title: Reading Is Not Using: Retrieval, Judgment, and the Design of AI Financial Research Workflows
title_translated: 阅读不等于使用：检索、判断与AI金融研究工作流的设计
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）正越来越多地被用作AI分析师来处理财务披露信息并支持AI辅助投资决策。然而，这类系统通常仅根据其检索能力进行评估，而非其检索信息是否真正影响判断。我们识别出长上下文财务分析中的‘检索-整合’差距。在固定核心企业信息、仅改变无关上下文长度（从2,000到128,000 tokens）的情况下，尽管直接检索仍保持准确，风险披露对投资判断的影响已降至实验噪声水平。该模式在不同模型家族和判断任务中均复现，并在移除实际10-K文件中真实披露内容的实验中依然成立。更强大的模型仅延迟而非消除这一差距。因果记忆干预表明，压缩摘要与源文本查找共同将披露信息传递至判断中。工作流架构决定了这种传递是否成功：分块-摘要流水线会剔除相关信息，而靠近决策点的有目标、结构化的重述则能恢复其影响力。因此，AI分析师的表现由模型能力与工作流架构共同决定。基于检索的评估可能认证那些对其明显检索到的信息视而不见的系统。

summary: We present Crase, a bounded and inspectable alternative to deep research agents for scholarly search. Instead of an open-ended search loop, Crase queries a search engine once for seed papers, expands them along their 1.5-hop citation neighborhood, prunes citation edges whose claims lack entailment support, and ranks the remaining papers with a recency-aware random walk. This makes the candidate set, the reason each paper is kept, and the stopping condition explicit and fixed before inference. On LitSearch and one further benchmarks over a 500K-paper arXiv corpus, Crase outperforms deep research agents built on proprietary models by up to 3$\times$ recall@50 at roughly a third of the cost.
title: Structurally-bounded Agentic Graph Exploration for Evidence-Grounded Scholarly DeepSearch
title_translated: 结构受限的智能体图探索用于证据驱动的学术深度搜索
summary_translated: 我们提出Crase，一种用于学术搜索的结构化且可解释的替代方案，以取代开放式的深度研究智能体。不同于无限制的搜索循环，Crase首先通过搜索引擎查询种子论文，然后在其1.5跳引用邻域内扩展，剔除缺乏蕴含支持的引用边，最后使用考虑时效性的随机游走对剩余论文进行排序。这使得候选集、每篇论文保留的原因以及停止条件在推理前均明确且固定。在涵盖50万篇arXiv论文的LitSearch及其他基准测试中，Crase在召回率@50上优于基于专有模型构建的深度研究智能体，最高达3倍，且成本仅为三分之一。

summary: Distinguishing machine-generated text (MGT) from human-written text (HWT) becomes increasingly important due to potential misuse. However, most supervised detectors often degrade out-of-domain (OOD) and require large, diverse training sets. In this work, we analyze the linearity and quality of MGT representations and show that simple linear probes outperform a wide range of detectors while being substantially more sample-efficient. We first show that MGT and HWT latent representations are linearly separable in low-dimensional space, and provide a plausible explanation for this separability through systematic differences in their representation quality. Motivated by these insights, we train two variants of simple linear probes and evaluate them across 4 benchmarks against 16 baselines. Probes consistently improve OOD detection (+11 AUC), requiring solely ${<}100$ samples to reach near-peak performance. We show that this transferability arises because probes recover a shared latent MGT direction that generalizes across diverse settings. Finally, we demonstrate that probing vectors capture a continuous spectrum of ``machineness'', highlighting their potential for fine-grained estimation of AI-edited text. Overall, our work provides insights into latent-space differences between MGT and HWT and demonstrates the potential of linear probes as as robust and sample-efficient MGT detectors. We release our code on~\href{https://github.com/gerritq/mgt_probes}{github}.
title: Linear Probing Provides Robust and Efficient Detection of Machine-Generated Text
title_translated: 线性探测提供稳健高效的机器生成文本检测方法
summary_translated: 由于潜在滥用风险，区分机器生成文本（MGT）与人类撰写文本（HWT）变得日益重要。然而，大多数监督式检测器在域外（OOD）场景下性能下降，且需要大规模多样化的训练数据。本文分析了MGT表示的线性特征与质量，发现简单的线性探测器在多种检测器中表现更优，且样本效率显著更高。我们首先证明MGT与HWT的潜在表示在低维空间中具有线性可分性，并通过系统性差异解释其可分性。受此启发，我们训练了两种简单线性探测器变体，并在4个基准上与16种基线对比。探测器在OOD检测中持续提升（AUC+11），仅需少于100个样本即可接近峰值性能。我们证明这种泛化能力源于探测器恢复了一个共享的MGT潜在方向，可在多种设置中通用。最后，我们展示探测向量能够捕捉从‘机器性’到‘人工性’的连续谱，凸显其在精细估计AI编辑文本方面的潜力。总体而言，本工作揭示了MGT与HWT在潜在空间中的差异，并展示了线性探测器作为稳健且高效MGT检测器的潜力。代码已发布于https://github.com/gerritq/mgt_probes。

summary: Text-to-CAD aims to generate executable CAD programs from natural-language descriptions. However, real-world descriptions are often underspecified and omit critical spatial constraints required for valid CAD construction, a challenge that has been largely overlooked by existing methods. In this paper, we argue that missing spatial constraints should be inferred with respect to the underlying construction structure and informed by reusable design experience. Based on this insight, we propose ExpConCAD, an experience-enhanced framework for implicit spatial constraint completion. ExpConCAD first recovers the intended construction structure and constraint scopes, then retrieves relevant constraint-completion experience for similar scopes to complete the missing spatial constraints, and finally generates executable CadQuery programs. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of ExpConCAD and provide insights into the role of construction structure understanding and experience memory in spatial constraint completion. Our code is available at: https://github.com/Hotjiashell/ExpConCAD.
title: ExpConCAD: Experience-Guided Text-to-CAD Generation from Shape Descriptions with Implicit Spatial Constraints
title_translated: ExpConCAD：基于形状描述与隐式空间约束的经验引导型文本到CAD生成
summary_translated: 文本到CAD旨在从自然语言描述生成可执行的CAD程序。然而，现实世界中的描述往往信息不足，遗漏了有效CAD构建所必需的关键空间约束，这一挑战在现有方法中被严重忽视。本文认为，缺失的空间约束应基于底层构造结构推断，并借助可复用的设计经验进行补充。基于此洞察，我们提出ExpConCAD，一种增强经验的记忆机制以完成隐式空间约束的框架。ExpConCAD首先恢复预期的构造结构与约束范围，然后为相似范围检索相关约束补全经验，最终生成可执行的CadQuery程序。大量实验验证了ExpConCAD的有效性，并揭示了构造结构理解与经验记忆在空间约束补全中的关键作用。代码已公开于：https://github.com/Hotjiashell/ExpConCAD。

summary: Evaluating Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems requires assessing not only end-to-end correctness but also how individual components interact and how errors propagate through the pipeline. We introduce a Bayesian evaluation framework that jointly models retrieval success, abstention behavior, and answer correctness, factorized according to the pipeline's information flow. The model distinguishes task success. Whether the user received a correct answer (from generator success) and whether the generator behaved appropriately given the retrieval outcome. We apply the framework to 27 RAG configurations across three datasets, three retrievers, and three generators, and show that the conditional decomposition reveals substantial behavioral differences between systems that appear equivalent under marginal metrics. We further analyze the annotation allocation problem, demonstrating that retrieval-success annotations are more informative than task-success annotations for estimating policy adherence, and provide an information-theoretic explanation for this asymmetry. Finally, we extend the model to incorporate LLM-as-a-judge annotations as calibrated noisy observations, enabling practitioners to combine limited human judgments with cheaper automated assessments within a unified probabilistic model.
title: The RAT: A Unified Bayesian Model for RAG Evaluation
title_translated: RAT：一种统一的贝叶斯模型用于RAG评估
summary_translated: 评估检索增强生成（RAG）系统不仅需要考察端到端的正确性，还需分析各个组件之间的交互方式以及错误在流水线中的传播情况。我们提出了一种贝叶斯评估框架，联合建模检索成功率、回避行为和答案正确性，并根据流水线的信息流进行因子分解。该模型区分了任务成功：用户是否获得正确答案（由生成器成功决定），以及在给定检索结果的情况下生成器的行为是否恰当。我们将该框架应用于三个数据集、三种检索器和三种生成器共27种RAG配置，结果显示，条件分解揭示了在边际指标下看似等价的系统之间存在显著的行为差异。我们进一步分析了标注分配问题，证明检索成功率的标注比任务成功率的标注更能有效估计策略遵循程度，并提供了这一不对称性的信息论解释。最后，我们将模型扩展为纳入大语言模型作为评判者（LLM-as-a-judge）的标注作为校准的噪声观测，使从业者能够在统一的概率模型中结合有限的人工判断与更低成本的自动化评估。

summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are trained with reinforcement learning (RL) for complex decision-making tasks. However, most RL-trained agents remain episodic and cannot accumulate reusable knowledge across episodes. Recent skill-based approaches, such as SkillRL, attempt to address this issue by extracting skills from raw trajectories, but treat the skill bank as an append-only repository without verifying whether stored skills remain effective. In this paper, we propose SkillForge, a framework for continuous skill evolution that enables skills to be verified and refined through environment interaction. By making skill usage explicit during agent interaction, RL can directly optimize both environment actions and skill invocation decisions. SkillForge further introduces evidence-based skill verification and multi-pathway skill induction, allowing the skill bank to continuously grow while maintaining its quality. Extensive experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, and AppWorld show that SkillForge consistently outperforms SkillRL, demonstrating the effectiveness of continuously verified skills in training stronger LLM agents.
title: SkillForge: Evolving Verifiable Skills for Reinforcement Learning Agents
title_translated: SkillForge：强化学习智能体可验证技能的持续演化
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体通过强化学习（RL）训练以完成复杂决策任务。然而，大多数RL训练的智能体仍为一次性行为，无法在不同回合间积累可复用的知识。近期基于技能的方法（如SkillRL）尝试通过从原始轨迹中提取技能来解决此问题，但将技能库视为仅可追加的存储库，未验证所存技能是否仍然有效。本文提出SkillForge框架，实现技能的持续演化，使技能可通过环境交互进行验证与优化。通过在智能体交互过程中显式表达技能使用，强化学习可直接优化环境动作与技能调用决策。SkillForge还引入基于证据的技能验证和多路径技能归纳机制，使技能库能够持续增长的同时保持高质量。在ALFWorld、WebShop和AppWorld上的大量实验表明，SkillForge始终优于SkillRL，证明持续验证技能在训练更强LLM智能体方面的有效性。

summary: Polygonal synthesis generates audio by traversing the perimeter of a polygon with a phasor; prior work uses a constant angular velocity, whereas the proposed system adopts constant arc-length (perimeter) velocity. Existing formulations operate on regular, parametrically defined polygons, producing smooth timbral transitions within a single family of shapes.   This paper generalizes polygonal synthesis around a unified arc-length engine: vertex data of any origin feed the same DSP pipeline. First, we adapt the oscillator to accept arbitrary vertex configurations from an external buffer, opening the possibility for a broad class of closed polygons -- regular, irregular, or star-shaped -- to function as a waveform generator. Second, a hybrid interpolation algorithm enables smooth morphing between polygons with unequal vertex counts, passing through intermediate shapes that have no parametric description. Third, we extend the paradigm to three dimensions: a convex polyhedron rotated about three axes is sliced by a fixed horizontal plane, and the resulting cross-section yields a continuously variable polygon controlled by the solid's orientation. The system runs in RNBO (Cycling~'74) with a geometry caching strategy that avoids per-sample recomputation. Antialiasing combines a four-point polyBLAMP correction derived from runtime Bézier tangents with adaptive oversampling, adapting the correction geometrically to general vertex configurations without per-shape analytical derivation.
title: Arbitrary Polygon Oscillator: Generalizing Polygonal Synthesis to Arbitrary Shapes, Morphing, and Three-Dimensional Polyhedra
comment: Accepted at 29th International Conference on Digital Audio Effects September 1 - 4, 2026 MIT, Cambridge, MA, USA
title_translated: 任意多边形振荡器：将多边形合成推广至任意形状、形态变化及三维多面体
summary_translated: 多边形合成通过相位器遍历多边形周长生成音频；以往工作采用恒定角速度，而本系统采用恒定弧长（周长）速度。现有方法仅适用于参数化定义的规则多边形，产生同一类形状内的平滑音色过渡。本文围绕统一的弧长引擎对多边形合成进行泛化：任意来源的顶点数据均可输入相同的数字信号处理（DSP）流水线。首先，我们改进振荡器以接受来自外部缓冲区的任意顶点配置，从而允许各类闭合多边形——规则、不规则或星形——作为波形发生器。其次，采用混合插值算法实现顶点数量不同的多边形之间的平滑形态变化，经过无参数描述的中间形状。第三，将范式拓展至三维：一个绕三轴旋转的凸多面体被固定水平平面切割，所得截面形成随实体方向连续变化的多边形。系统运行于RNBO（Cycling '74）平台，采用几何缓存策略避免逐样本重计算。抗混叠处理结合基于运行时贝塞尔切线的四点polyBLAMP校正与自适应过采样，几何上适配一般顶点配置，无需针对每种形状进行解析推导。

summary: While text-based hallucination detection has been extensively studied, spoken hallucination detection remains largely unexplored, particularly for low-resource languages. We present the first multilingual spoken hallucination benchmark comprising 12,013 news samples across English, Russian, and Kazakh with controlled hallucinations of three types and three severity levels. Samples comprise original articles and aligned hallucinated counterparts in text and audio. We complement the synthetic corpus with 290 fact-checked fake news items collected natively in Russian (225) and Kazakh (65), translated into the other language and rendered through the same TTS-ASR pipeline. We assess fine-tuned multilingual encoders and, in zero-shot in-context settings, multimodal decoder models on transcript-based versus direct audio processing. Transcript-based detection generally outperforms direct audio processing, with binary-task degradation for strong encoders tracking per-language ASR error. On real-world fakes, synthetic-trained detectors transfer strongly (macro-F1 0.82-0.88 on original text), while Russian provenance analysis reveals both veracity-related and model-dependent machine-style signals, quantifying a key confound in synthetic hallucination benchmarks.
title: Lost in Speech: Trilingual Spoken Hallucination Detection Across Audio and Transcripts
title_translated: 语音中的迷失：跨音频与文本的三语口语幻觉检测
summary_translated: 尽管基于文本的幻觉检测已得到广泛研究，但口语幻觉检测仍基本未被探索，尤其在低资源语言中。我们提出了首个多语言口语幻觉基准，包含英语、俄语和哈萨克语共12,013条新闻样本，涵盖三种类型的受控幻觉及三个严重程度等级。样本包括原始文章及其对齐的幻觉版本，同时提供文本与音频形式。我们补充了一个真实虚假新闻语料库，其中290个经事实核查的假新闻项为原生俄语（225个）和哈萨克语（65个），并翻译至其他语言，通过相同的TTS-ASR流水线生成。我们在微调的多语言编码器以及零样本上下文设置下的多模态解码器模型上，评估了基于转录文本与直接音频处理两种方式的表现。总体而言，基于转录文本的检测优于直接音频处理，强编码器在二分类任务中的性能下降与各语言ASR错误率相关。在真实世界假新闻上，合成训练的检测器表现出强迁移能力（原始文本上宏平均F1为0.82–0.88），而俄语来源分析揭示了与真实性相关的信号以及模型依赖的机器风格特征，量化了合成幻觉基准中的一个关键混淆因素。

summary: Persian (Farsi) is often described as a low-resource language in natural language processing, but that label collapses distinct shortages into a single category. This paper argues that Persian is more precisely described as annotation-scarce, provided that the term is understood as a property of its NLP resource ecology rather than an intrinsic property of the language. The review covers 34 representative Persian text resources available by July 2026 and adds three quantitative cross-checks. First, independent web measurements place Persian among roughly the twenty most visible content languages: W3Techs reports Persian on about 0.9% of websites with a known content language, while Common Crawl CC-MAIN-2026-30 identifies Persian as the primary language of 0.7039% of HTML pages. Second, a selective speech review shows a long resource trajectory from FARSDAT to recent corpora containing hundreds or thousands of hours of speech. Third, a matched Persian-English comparison normalizes task-specific annotation volumes by relative Common Crawl web presence. The resulting ratios vary sharply: Persian syntax and news NER are comparatively dense, whereas natural-language inference falls below the web-proportional baseline. The evidence therefore does not support a simple claim that Persian is globally deficient in labeled volume. Instead, annotation scarcity is expressed through uneven task and domain coverage, incompatible schemes, access and documentation friction, and limited supervision for specialist domains, preference data, and varieties beyond standard Iranian Persian.
title: The Annotation Bottleneck in Persian Text NLP: Persian as an Annotation-Scarce Language
title_translated: 波斯语文本NLP中的标注瓶颈：波斯语作为一种标注稀缺语言
summary_translated: 波斯语（法尔斯语）常被描述为自然语言处理中的低资源语言，但这一标签将多种短缺合并为单一类别，具有误导性。本文认为，更准确的说法是波斯语属于标注稀缺语言，前提是将‘标注稀缺’理解为NLP资源生态的属性，而非语言本身的固有特性。本文回顾了截至2026年7月可用的34个代表性波斯语文本资源，并进行了三项定量交叉验证。第一，独立网络测量显示波斯语在内容语言中排名约前二十：W3Techs报告波斯语占已知内容语言网站的约0.9%，Common Crawl CC-MAIN-2026-30则识别出波斯语为0.7039%的HTML页面的主要语言。第二，选择性语音资源审查显示，从FARSDAT到近年包含数百或数千小时语音的语料库，呈现出长期发展轨迹。第三，通过相对Common Crawl网页存在度对波斯语与英语的任务特定标注量进行归一化比较。结果显示比例差异显著：波斯语句法和新闻命名实体识别相对密集，而自然语言推理则低于按网页比例预期的基线。因此，证据并不支持波斯语在全球标注量上普遍不足的简单结论。相反，标注稀缺表现为任务与领域覆盖不均、方案不兼容、访问与文档障碍，以及专业领域、偏好数据和标准伊朗波斯语以外变体的监督数据匮乏。

summary: One algorithmic composition may require a Csound score, engraved notation, real-time control, and a rehearsal click. Authored separately, their timelines drift. Temporal System is a Wolfram Language paclet that instead compiles one immutable store of typed entities on a rational beat timeline through backend-specific contracts. It emits Csound synthesis, beta MusicXML 4.0, OSC control, and click artifacts that remain synchronized because they share that store. Conversion to seconds, samples, or hertz occurs only at render time. Csound notes use stable named instruments in external .orc files; curves become k-rate signals declared against score p-fields. The click backend derives rehearsal audio from the same meter and tempo and reuses the Csound serializer. We describe the temporal, semantic, and rendering-contract layers, their practical trade-offs, and the limits of this proprietary authoring environment within an otherwise open-source ecosystem. The archived supplement exposes the reported outputs pending paclet release.
title: One Timeline, Many Renderings: A Wolfram Language Paclet for heterogeneous musical output
comment: Accepted at the International Csound Conference (ICSC) 2026
title_translated: 一条时间线，多种呈现：用于异构音乐输出的Wolfram语言包
summary_translated: 一种算法作曲可能需要Csound乐谱、排版记谱、实时控制和排练节拍。这些组件若分别编写，其时间线会逐渐错位。时序系统是一个Wolfram语言包，通过后端特定的契约，将一个不可变的、带类型的实体存储在理性的节拍时间线上。它生成与Csound合成、Beta MusicXML 4.0、OSC控制和节拍信号，这些输出因共享同一存储而保持同步。秒、样本或赫兹的转换仅在渲染时发生。Csound音符使用外部.orc文件中的稳定命名乐器；曲线则作为针对乐谱p字段声明的k速率信号。节拍后端从相同的节拍和速度中推导出排练音频，并复用Csound序列化器。我们描述了时间、语义和渲染契约层，它们的实际权衡，以及这种专有创作环境在开放源码生态系统中的局限性。归档补充材料展示了报告的输出结果，待包发布。

summary: Markov models are established tools for symbolic music, including non-homogeneous formulations. The narrower contribution examined here is an observation-driven estimation mechanism: overlapping sliding windows derive a trajectory of local transition kernels from one symbolic sequence rather than from an exogenous formal partition. We test this mechanism on 273 logical note events from Debussy's Syrinx (1913), using the often-proposed A-B-A' reading as a reference rather than ground truth. We apply the same validation to absolute-pitch and notated-duration kernels. At $L=6$, both reference boundaries attain the Jensen--Shannon maximum in both dimensions; the duration plateau is substantially narrower (64 of 267 comparisons) than the pitch plateau (210 of 267). Because the theoretical maximum for consecutive sliding-window comparisons is set by window geometry and equals $1/\sqrt{L-1}$ for maximal turnover of the entering/leaving transition, the pitch value at $L=6$ and its broad plateau are not, by themselves, strong evidence. Their cross-dimensional alignment is consistent with boundary sensitivity, while the broad plateaus preclude treating either curve alone as a unique automatic segmenter. Five-hundred-draw re-synthesis experiments quantify departure from the source in both dimensions and expose an exact-copy degeneracy at $L=2$.
title: From local kernels to global form: modeling the emergence of musical content

title_translated: 从局部核到整体形式：音乐内容涌现的建模
summary_translated: 马尔可夫模型是符号音乐中的成熟工具，包括非齐次形式。本文更狭义的贡献在于一种基于观察的估计机制：通过重叠滑动窗口，从单一符号序列中推导出局部转移核轨迹，而非依赖外部的形式划分。我们在德彪西《西林克斯》（1913）的273个逻辑音符事件上测试该机制，以常被提出的A-B-A'结构为参考而非真实标准。我们对绝对音高和记谱时长核也进行了相同验证。当L=6时，两个参考边界在两个维度上均达到Jensen-Shannon最大值；时长平台明显较窄（267次比较中64次），远小于音高平台（267次中210次）。由于连续滑动窗口比较的理论最大值由窗口几何决定，且等于1/√(L−1)（对应进入/离开转移的最大周转率），因此仅凭L=6时的音高值及其宽平台并不能构成强证据。但跨维度的一致性与边界敏感性一致，而宽平台又排除了单独将任一曲线视为唯一自动分段器的可能性。500次重合成实验量化了在两个维度上对源数据的偏离，并揭示了L=2时的精确复制退化现象。

summary: Conversational AI systems (CAISes) continuously change through model releases, feature updates, safety interventions, and access-policy shifts, yet user perceptions are often studied as static snapshots. We conduct a long-term, large-scale analysis of Reddit discussions to examine how users perceive CAIS model release interventions across providers. By combining sentiment classification and thematic concept analysis, we show that CAIS perceptions are dynamic and intervention-sensitive. Anthropic exhibits the clearest positive release profile through Claude Code and product-model fit, OpenAI shows backlash-and-recovery dynamics around GPT-5 and GPT-5.1, Grok-3 is shaped by provider identity and political discourse, and DeepSeek-R1 combines engineering praise with concerns about censorship, access, and reliability. These findings show that model releases are not merely technical updates, but user-facing interventions that reshape sentiment, expectations, and public discussion.
title: Expectation, Backlash, Recovery, and Excitement: How Model Releases Shape Reddit Perceptions of Conversational AI Systems

title_translated: 期望、反弹、恢复与兴奋：模型发布如何塑造用户对对话式AI系统的认知
summary_translated: 对话式AI系统（CAISes）通过模型发布、功能更新、安全干预和访问政策调整持续演变，但用户感知常被当作静态快照研究。我们开展了一项长期、大规模的Reddit讨论分析，考察用户对不同提供商CAIS模型发布干预的感知。结合情感分类与主题概念分析，我们发现CAIS感知是动态且对干预敏感的。Anthropic通过Claude Code和产品-模型契合度展现出最清晰的正面发布表现；OpenAI在GPT-5及GPT-5.1发布后表现出反弹与恢复动态；Grok-3受提供商标识与政治话语影响；DeepSeek-R1则兼具工程赞誉与对审查、访问和可靠性问题的担忧。这些发现表明，模型发布不仅是技术更新，更是面向用户的干预，重塑了情感、期望与公众讨论。

summary: Can language models be trusted in safety- critical operations? In such settings, strong per- formance on semantic metrics does not guaran- tee operational reliability: a misread altitude, a dropped execution condition, or a confused call- sign may score well under standard F1 yet carry sharply asymmetric operational consequences. We study this problem in air traffic control (ATC), where controller-pilot communication demands near-zero error tolerance, and use consequence-aware evaluation to test whether semantic scores misstate operational reliabil- ity. The framework is instantiated in a con- trolled diagnostic ATC benchmark grounded in aviation standards and feedback from 40 air traffic controllers across three countries. Evaluating 8 models, we uncover a system- atic semantic-safety gap: conventional scores give substantially higher performance estimates than consequence-aware evaluation, even for models that appear reliable under standard met- rics. Risk-aware fine-tuning narrows but does not close this gap, showing that consequence- aware evaluation is a necessary complement to standard NLP metrics before any real safety- critical deployment claim
title: Beyond Semantic Accuracy: Consequence-Aware Evaluation for Safety-Critical Language Understanding
title_translated: 超越语义准确率：面向安全关键型语言理解的后果感知评估
summary_translated: 语言模型能否在安全关键操作中被信任？在这些场景中，语义指标上的优异表现并不能保证实际运行可靠性：误读高度、遗漏执行条件或混淆呼号可能在标准F1评分中得分良好，却带来严重不对称的操作后果。我们在空中交通管制（ATC）领域研究此问题，该领域要求管制员与飞行员沟通近乎零误差容忍。我们采用后果感知评估方法，检验语义评分是否夸大了实际可靠性。该框架在基于航空标准并结合来自三个国家40名空中交通管制员反馈的受控诊断ATC基准中实现。评估8个模型后，我们发现存在系统性的语义-安全差距：即使在标准指标下看似可靠的模型，其常规评分也显著高于后果感知评估结果。风险感知微调虽缩小了这一差距，但未能完全消除，表明后果感知评估是任何真实安全关键部署前，对标准NLP指标的必要补充。

summary: Post-training quantization lowers the memory footprint of Large Language Models (LLMs) and speeds up inference, which is why it is now common for on-device deployment. Most of what we know about its effects, however, comes from English benchmarks. It is not clear whether the same holds for morphologically complex, low-resource languages such as Bangla, and this gap is what we address here. We evaluate three model families---Qwen-2.5-7B, LLaMA-3.1-8B, and GPT-OSS-20B---in full precision and in three quantized formats (GPTQ-Int8, GPTQ-Q8, GGUF-W8A16) across five Bangla natural language understanding benchmarks (Bangla MMLU, CommonsenseQA-BN, OpenBookQA-BN, PIQA-BN, and BoolQ-BN), using zero-shot evaluation through lm-evaluation-harness. To our knowledge this is the first controlled comparison of quantization formats on Bangla NLU. The three families do not respond the same way: GPT-OSS loses up to 57.35% accuracy on reasoning-heavy tasks under GGUF-W8A16, while Qwen and LLaMA hold steady under GPTQ, and in a few cases the quantized version edges out the full-precision one. BoolQ-BN, a comprehension task, stays stable across all three families regardless of format. Taken together, these results suggest quantization can work well for Bangla deployment, but the choice of architecture and quantization method matters more than the bit width alone. We discuss what this means for practitioners choosing a model to run on constrained hardware.
title: Quantization Effects on Bangla Language Understanding in Large Language Models: A Systematic Evaluation
title_translated: 量化对大型语言模型中孟加拉语理解的影响：一项系统性评估
summary_translated: 训练后量化降低了大型语言模型（LLMs）的内存占用并加速推理，因此现已成为设备端部署的常见做法。然而，我们目前所知的大多数量化影响均来自英语基准。尚不清楚这些结论是否适用于形态复杂、资源匮乏的语言如孟加拉语，这正是本文要解决的问题。我们评估了三种模型家族——Qwen-2.5-7B、LLaMA-3.1-8B和GPT-OSS-20B——在全精度和三种量化格式（GPTQ-Int8、GPTQ-Q8、GGUF-W8A16）下的表现，涵盖五个孟加拉语自然语言理解基准（Bangla MMLU、CommonsenseQA-BN、OpenBookQA-BN、PIQA-BN和BoolQ-BN），采用lm-evaluation-harness进行零样本评估。据我们所知，这是首次对孟加拉语NLU中量化格式的受控比较。三种模型家族响应方式不同：GPT-OSS在GGUF-W8A16下于推理密集任务上最高损失达57.35%准确率，而Qwen和LLaMA在GPTQ下保持稳定，甚至在少数情况下量化版本优于全精度版本。BoolQ-BN（理解任务）在所有三种模型家族中无论格式均保持稳定。综合来看，这些结果表明量化可用于孟加拉语部署，但模型架构和量化方法的选择比比特宽度本身更为关键。我们讨论了这对在受限硬件上选择模型的实践者的意义。

summary: Self-Consistency (SC) is a decoding strategy that samples diverse reasoning paths and selects the most consistent answer, demonstrating strong performance on complex reasoning problems. However, the excessive token consumption incurred by generating multiple reasoning paths has been identified as a major limitation of SC. To improve computational efficiency, several studies have proposed strategies that adjust the number of reasoning paths or allocate resources differentially according to problem difficulty. Nevertheless, most existing methods categorize difficulty into a few fixed levels, failing to fully capture the continuously varying nature of reasoning complexity. In this work, we propose Flexible Self-Consistency (FSC), which estimates problem difficulty as a continuous signal and dynamically adjusts the number of generated reasoning paths accordingly. FSC predicts the output entropy of an input question using a pre-trained probe and leverages it as an indicator of model uncertainty to flexibly control the sampling budget. Experimental results show that, across various models and benchmarks, FSC maintains accuracy comparable to SC while achieving token savings of up to 76%.
title: Is Discrete Difficulty Sufficient? Leveraging Continuous Difficulty for Efficient Self-Consistency in LLMs
title_translated: 离散难度是否足够？利用连续难度实现大语言模型的高效自洽
summary_translated: 自洽（Self-Consistency, SC）是一种解码策略，通过采样多种推理路径并选择最一致的答案，在复杂推理问题上表现出色。然而，生成多条推理路径带来的大量 token 消耗被认定为 SC 的主要局限。为提升计算效率，已有研究提出根据问题难度调整推理路径数量或差异化分配资源的策略。但大多数现有方法将难度划分为少数固定等级，未能充分捕捉推理复杂性的连续变化特性。本文提出灵活自洽（Flexible Self-Consistency, FSC），将问题难度建模为连续信号，并据此动态调整生成的推理路径数量。FSC 使用预训练探测器预测输入问题的输出熵，将其作为模型不确定性的指标，以灵活控制采样预算。实验结果表明，在多种模型和基准测试中，FSC 在保持与 SC 相当准确率的同时，实现了高达 76% 的 token 节省。

summary: Proactive medical dialogue requires an agent to decide what to ask from incomplete patient information. Existing information-seeking approaches commonly prioritize questions that most reduce diagnostic uncertainty. While effective for acquiring informative evidence, this criterion overlooks an important property of medical diagnosis: different diagnostic errors can carry substantially different consequences. Missing a severe condition may matter more than reducing uncertainty among less consequential alternatives. Question acquisition should therefore consider not only how informative new evidence is, but also how it is expected to affect the downstream diagnostic decision. To this end, we propose Expected-Severity-Risk (ESR), a consequence-aware question-supervision objective that values each candidate by its expected reduction in severity-aware terminal risk. Because questions must be selected before their answers are observed, ESR marginalizes over possible answers using train-only population statistics. Its rankings are then distilled into a prefix-only language policy, so next-question selection requires no teacher-side computation at deployment. Across three Qwen3-4B training seeds on DDxPlus, matched ESR supervision reduces mean high-severity diagnostic miss from .0645 to .0455 (-29.5%) and improves mean diagnostic accuracy from .9123 to .9320 while requiring only 0.14 additional questions per dialogue. Fixed-budget analyses show that the two objectives remain behaviorally distinct when question count is controlled, while a matched expected-0/1-risk control shows that severity-aware weighting improves the high-severity error profile beyond generic decision-aware supervision. These results support moving proactive medical dialogue beyond uncertainty reduction toward consequence-aware evidence acquisition.
title: Beyond Information Seeking: Severity-Aware Question Supervision for Proactive Medical Dialogue
title_translated: 超越信息获取：面向主动医疗对话的严重性感知问题监督
summary_translated: 主动医疗对话要求智能体在患者信息不完整的情况下决定应提出哪些问题。现有的信息获取方法通常优先选择能最大程度降低诊断不确定性的提问。尽管该准则在获取信息性证据方面有效，却忽略了医学诊断中一个关键属性：不同诊断错误可能带来截然不同的后果。遗漏严重疾病的影响远大于在次要选项间减少不确定性。因此，问题获取不仅应考虑新证据的信息量，还应评估其对下游诊断决策的预期影响。为此，我们提出期望严重性风险（Expected-Severity-Risk, ESR），一种后果感知的问题监督目标，通过评估每个候选问题在降低严重性感知终局风险方面的预期贡献来赋值。由于问题需在答案出现前选定，ESR 利用仅在训练阶段可用的人群统计信息对可能答案进行边缘化处理。其排序结果被提炼为仅基于前缀的语言策略，使得部署时无需教师端计算。在 DDxPlus 上使用三个 Qwen3-4B 训练种子的实验表明，匹配的 ESR 监督将高严重性诊断遗漏率从 0.0645 降至 0.0455（下降 29.5%），同时将平均诊断准确率从 0.9123 提升至 0.9320，且每轮对话仅增加 0.14 个问题。固定预算分析显示，当问题数量受控时，两种目标行为仍明显不同；而与预期 0/1 风险对照组相比，严重性感知加权显著改善了高严重性错误分布，优于通用决策感知监督。这些结果支持将主动医疗对话从单纯降低不确定性转向后果感知的证据获取。

summary: Multilingual text embedding models enable cross-lingual transfer of knowledge across a wide range of NLP tasks, but their evaluation remains highly uneven across high-, mid- and low-resource languages. In this paper, we propose a two-dimensional framework, specifically tailored for analyzing multilingual embedding benchmarks under dataset scarcity, and apply it on the Slavic-language subset of the MTEB benchmark. The framework distinguishes between task-specific and cross-task evaluation, while jointly analyzing three complementary aspects: (1) ranking robustness, (2) model consistency, and (3) evidence strength. At the task-specific level, we evaluate the stability of model rankings under changes in ranking methodology and benchmark dataset composition. At the cross-task level, we assess the ability of models to generalize across diverse tasks within a language. To quantify the reliability of benchmark conclusions, we introduce an Evidence Strength Score that accounts for dataset availability, diversity, and robustness assessability. Our analysis reveals severe benchmark sparsity, with many Slavic language-task pairs relying on a single dataset or highly correlated benchmark collections, limiting the ability to draw robust conclusions. The cross-task analysis reveals a small group of highly transferable models, most notably llama-embed-nemotron-8b, multilingual-e5-large-instruct, and Qwen3-Embedding variants, that consistently perform well across Slavic languages and tasks. Overall, the results demonstrate that benchmark rankings and robustness conclusions must be interpreted jointly with certain notation of their evidence strength and highlight benchmark scarcity as a major obstacle to trustworthy multilingual evaluation.
title: Dataset Scarcity Limits Robust Evaluation of Multilingual Embedding Models: A Case Study of Slavic Languages
title_translated: 数据稀缺限制多语言嵌入模型的鲁棒评估：斯拉夫语系案例研究
summary_translated: 多语言文本嵌入模型可在广泛自然语言处理任务中实现跨语言知识迁移，但其评估在高、中、低资源语言之间极不均衡。本文提出一个专为分析数据稀缺条件下多语言嵌入基准而设计的二维框架，并应用于 MTEB 基准中的斯拉夫语子集。该框架区分任务特定与跨任务评估，同时联合分析三个互补维度：(1) 排名鲁棒性，(2) 模型一致性，(3) 证据强度。在任务特定层面，评估模型排名在排名方法和基准数据集组成变化下的稳定性；在跨任务层面，评估模型在单一语言内跨多样化任务的泛化能力。为量化基准结论的可靠性，引入证据强度评分，综合考虑数据可得性、多样性及鲁棒性可评估性。分析揭示严重的基准稀疏性，许多斯拉夫语言-任务组合仅依赖单一数据集或高度相关的基准集合，限制了得出稳健结论的能力。跨任务分析发现一小部分高度可迁移的模型表现突出，尤其是 llama-embed-nemotron-8b、multilingual-e5-large-instruct 和 Qwen3-Embedding 变体，在斯拉夫语言和任务中均持续表现优异。总体而言，结果表明基准排名与鲁棒性结论必须结合其证据强度进行解读，并强调数据稀缺是可信多语言评估的主要障碍。

summary: When a context asserts two values for one fact, a model commits to a cue -- recency, repetition, position -- but natural data rarely makes these disagree, so behavior cannot reveal which. We train 26M-parameter transformers on a synthetic language where recency and rarity are exactly coextensive, and separate them with a minimal causal edit that inverts one cue while holding the truth, token count and answer position fixed. All 75 runs reach accuracy >= 0.999, including where the trivial heuristic fails, so no held-in evaluation distinguishes them. Under intervention the per-cell readout does not replicate: 13 of 25 cells differ by more than 0.3 in sign fraction across three seeds, the largest by 0.879 against a standard error of 0.025. The construction predicts this -- coextensive rules leave the objective indifferent between them -- and the variance is ordered by how much of the optimization each comparison releases. What replicates is timing: escape from a positional shortcut with a closed-form ceiling, monotone in redundancy. Probed before that escape, attribution reverses sign in 32 of 75 runs at unchanged accuracy, and gating on circuit formation is necessary but not sufficient. The corpus fixes when a mechanism appears, not which one -- a criterion for when mechanistic attribution to data is available at all, and our construction makes the unavailable case exact.
title: Shortcut Before Circuit: Document Statistics Time In-Context Conflict Resolution
title_translated: 捷径先于电路：文档统计信息用于上下文冲突的解决
summary_translated: 当上下文对同一事实给出两个不同数值时，模型会依赖某种线索——如最近性、重复性或位置——但自然数据极少使这些线索相矛盾，因此无法通过行为判断哪个线索更优。我们训练了一个 2600 万参数的 Transformer 模型，使其在一种合成语言中学习近似共现的最近性和罕见性规则，并通过最小因果编辑反转其中一个线索，同时保持真实值、词元数量和答案位置不变。所有 75 次运行均达到 ≥0.999 的准确率，包括在简单启发式失效的情况下，因此在保留评估中无法区分它们。但在干预条件下，单个单元的读出结果并未复现：在三个种子下，25 个单元中有 13 个的符号占比差异超过 0.3，最大差异达 0.879，标准误差仅为 0.025。该构造预测了这一现象——共现规则使目标对两者无偏好——且方差按每次比较释放的优化量有序排列。真正可复现的是时间特征：从位置捷径中逃脱的时间点具有闭式上限，单调依赖冗余度。在逃脱前进行探测，75 次运行中有 32 次归因符号反转，而准确率不变；电路形成时的门控是必要但非充分条件。语料库决定了机制何时出现，而非具体是哪一个——这成为判断数据可机械归因的唯一标准，而我们的构造使不可归因的情况变得精确。

summary: Language can be considered a design material in architecture, and in the context of text-to-X generative AI models becoming a common tool for architectural practice, looking more closely at language is more important now than in the past. After describing some of the important developments in linguistics starting from Wittgenstein, and including the work of Chomsky, Lakoff, conceptual and generative metaphors as proposed by Schön, this chapter connects them to contemporary architectural design and generative text-to-X tools. The chapter builds on the idea that three main forms of language intertwine in architectural design done using generative AI, namely (I) discourse (or natural language which can contain professional terminology specific to our field), (II) programming languages (which are artificial languages sitting at the basis of all computational systems), and (III) annotations (as language elements attached to pieces of data). It concludes by outlining a research agenda for connecting generative metaphors to generative AI: (a) conducting corpus linguistics studies on architectural texts (using quantitative tools such as topic modelling, and qualitative tools such as discourse analysis); (b) bringing communication theory and information studies closer to architectural research and (c) taking into account that different (natural) languages come with different affordances meaning generative and conceptual metaphors differ in relation to this.
title: Words, Spaces and Generative AI: Layers of language in contemporary architecture
title_translated: 词语、空间与生成式人工智能：当代建筑中的语言层次
summary_translated: 语言可被视为建筑中的设计材料，随着文本到X的生成式AI模型成为建筑实践中的常用工具，深入审视语言比以往任何时候都更为重要。本文回顾了从维特根斯坦开始的重要语言学发展，包括乔姆斯基、拉科夫以及 Schön 提出的概念与生成隐喻理论，并将这些思想与当代建筑设计及生成式文本到X工具相联系。文章提出，在使用生成式AI进行建筑设计时，三种主要语言形式相互交织：(I) 话语（即自然语言，可包含本领域特有的专业术语），(II) 编程语言（作为所有计算系统基础的人工语言），(III) 注释（作为附加到数据片段上的语言元素）。最后，文章勾勒出连接生成隐喻与生成式AI的研究议程：(a) 对建筑文本开展语料库语言学研究（使用主题建模等定量工具及话语分析等定性工具）；(b) 将传播理论与信息研究更紧密地融入建筑研究；(c) 考虑不同自然语言具有不同的功能特性，因此生成与概念隐喻会因语言而异。

summary: To reduce the hallucination risk caused by outcome-driven rewards in large language models trained through reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, existing mitigation approaches introduce process-level factual supervision. However, due to coarse-grained aggregation of factual signals and the lack of reliability assessment for these signals, they create a mismatch between fact verification and policy updates. We term this noisy factual credit assignment and decompose it into two aspects: credit localization ambiguity and credit reliability ambiguity. To address these issues, we propose FARCA (Fact-Aligned Reliability-Aware Credit Assignment), a policy optimization framework that transforms factual supervision into localized, reliability-weighted token-level training signals. FARCA achieves fine-grained credit localization by aligning the granularity of fact verification with that of policy updates. It further introduces counterfactual evidence attribution, which uses the dependence of a factual judgment on key evidence as an empirical proxy for verification reliability to compute reliability weights. These weights modulate factual rewards and local policy advantages, reducing the influence of potentially unreliable signals on policy optimization. Experiments across different models and multiple factual reasoning benchmarks show that FARCA significantly improves model factuality while preserving general reasoning capabilities.
title: FARCA: Fact-Aligned Reliability-Aware Credit Assignment for Reinforcement Learning with Factual Supervision
title_translated: FARCA：事实对齐的可靠性感知信用分配，用于具有事实监督的强化学习
summary_translated: 为降低在可验证奖励驱动下通过强化学习训练的大语言模型中因结果导向奖励导致的幻觉风险，现有缓解方法引入了过程级的事实监督。然而，由于事实信号的粗粒度聚合以及缺乏对这些信号可靠性的评估，导致事实验证与策略更新之间存在不匹配。我们称这种噪声事实信用分配为信用定位模糊和信用可靠性模糊。为解决这些问题，我们提出FARCA（事实对齐的可靠性感知信用分配），一种将事实监督转化为局部化、可靠性加权的token级训练信号的策略优化框架。FARCA通过将事实验证的粒度与策略更新对齐，实现细粒度的信用定位。此外，它引入反事实证据归因，利用事实判断对关键证据的依赖性作为验证可靠性的经验代理，以计算可靠性权重。这些权重调节事实奖励和局部策略优势，减少潜在不可靠信号对策略优化的影响。在不同模型和多个事实推理基准上的实验表明，FARCA显著提升了模型的事实性，同时保持了通用推理能力。

summary: Activation steering can change behaviour without establishing that the effect is specific to the intended concept. We introduce SteerCheck, a preregistered attribution audit that matches off-target KL and separates mean, protected-tail, polarity, transfer, and semantic claims. Exact replay of 960 Qwen3-14B interventions reveals complementary limits of common controls: isotropic directions occupy a narrow near-orthogonal region, whereas sign-randomized same-construction directions often retain substantial target alignment. Effect is strongly associated with signed cosine within the sign-randomized family ($ρ=.94$); $25.3\%$ of its draws exceed cosine $.5$, and every draw exceeding the observed mean effect has cosine above $.80$. This alignment leakage does not by itself invalidate a conditional randomization test; it limits what the comparator can distinguish and motivates reporting exchangeability assumptions, a construction diagnostic $A$, and the empirical cosine distribution. The primary Qwen complete gate remains negative because the protected tail fails all families. On independent data, continuous margin transfers only in Qwen and accuracy transfers in no selected cell. Prospectively registered language controls pass the complete gate in Qwen and DeepSeek, while a passing DeepSeek detox comparator rules out categorical separation; all nominal passes are sensitive to $Γ=1.10$. Frozen three-rater open-generation evaluation supports factual correction in DeepSeek but not Qwen; the automatic judge fails calibration (macro-F1 $.562$), so null-wide semantic results remain descriptive. SteerCheck makes these conditional and mixed conclusions auditable.
title: SteerCheck: Attribution Specificity and Alignment Leakage in Activation-Steering Audits
title_translated: SteerCheck：激活引导审计中的归因特异性与对齐泄漏
summary_translated: 激活引导可以在不确认其效果是否特定于预期概念的情况下改变行为。我们提出了SteerCheck，一种预先注册的归因审计方法，用于匹配非目标KL并分离均值、保护尾部、极性、迁移和语义声明。对960次Qwen3-14B干预的精确重放揭示了常见控制方法的互补局限性：各向同性方向占据狭窄的近正交区域，而符号随机化的同构造方向通常仍保留显著的目标对齐。效应与符号随机家族内的符号余弦高度相关（ρ=.94）；其抽样中有25.3%超过余弦值0.5，且所有超过观测平均效应的抽样值余弦均高于0.80。这种对齐泄漏本身并不否定条件随机化检验的有效性；它限制了比较器所能区分的能力，并促使报告可交换性假设、构造诊断指标A以及经验余弦分布。主要Qwen完整门控仍为负，因为保护尾部在所有家族中均未通过。在独立数据上，连续边际转移仅在Qwen中出现，而准确率转移在任何选定单元中均未发生。前瞻性注册的语言控制在Qwen和DeepSeek中通过完整门控，而通过的DeepSeek去毒比较器排除了类别分离；所有名义通过结果对Γ=1.10敏感。冻结的三评者开放式生成评估支持DeepSeek的事实修正，但不支持Qwen；自动评判器校准失败（宏F1=0.562），因此全零语义结果仍为描述性。SteerCheck使这些条件性和混合性结论可审计。

summary: With the advent of Large Language Models and its instruction following capabilities a promising application is the task of summarization. Within this domain of task the extractive sub-task of clinical protocolling has emerged as a topic of particular interest as it can significantly reduce the downtime and protocolling burden of health-care workers thus enabling them to focus on their core work helping humans. A further step towards automation is the direct generation of clinical notes from speech without intermediate transcripts, reducing processing time while preserving information such as coughing or other paralinguistic cues that may be lost in transcript-based systems. To this end, we present KIT's submission to this years BeTraC challenge in the lightweight track. Our main contribution is a scalable data augmentation pipeline that unifies heterogeneous medical dialogue datasets through synthetic speech generation and automatically generated SOAP supervision, enabling robust adaptation of a speech foundation model for end-to-end speech-to-SOAP generation.
title: Speech-to-SOAP: End-to-End Summarization of Medical Dialogues: KIT@BeTraC 2026
title_translated: Speech-to-SOAP：医学对话的端到端摘要：KIT@BeTraC 2026
summary_translated: 随着大语言模型及其指令遵循能力的发展，摘要任务成为一个有前景的应用领域。在此领域中，临床记录的抽取子任务尤为引人关注，因为它能显著减少医护人员的停机时间和记录负担，使其能够专注于核心工作以帮助人类。进一步迈向自动化的是直接从语音生成临床笔记，无需中间转录文本，从而缩短处理时间，同时保留咳嗽或其他副语言线索等可能在基于转录的系统中丢失的信息。为此，我们提交了今年BeTraC挑战赛轻量级赛道的KIT方案。我们的主要贡献是一个可扩展的数据增强管道，通过合成语音生成和自动生成的SOAP监督，统一异构的医学对话数据集，从而实现对语音基础模型的稳健适配，以支持端到端的语音到SOAP生成。

summary: Deep research (DR) systems produce long-form cited reports by orchestrating multiple agents that search and synthesize information from the web. Citations are the primary mechanism for evaluating the faithfulness of these reports, yet current DR systems exhibit poor citation recall. Moreover, improving citation recall is challenging because DR systems are complex multi-agent architectures where information passes through agents like a telephone game, and both content and citations can get corrupted along the way. We propose an evaluation method that pinpoints which agent introduced each error by locally testing agent invocations for faithfulness and verifiability relative to their own inputs. Furthermore, we propose a four-type taxonomy to categorize the discovered errors: hallucination, uncited input reliance, uncited output, or insufficient citations. Applying our method to three top-ranked open-source DR systems, we obtain actionable diagnostics. Almost every agent makes a lot of mistakes with the exception being those that summarize a single document. We find that the dominant error type varies systematically across agents, where the orchestrator mistakes are mostly citation-related. We find that 84.7% of final-report errors in AI-Q originate at the orchestrator, roughly 31% of them hallucinations and the rest citation mistakes. Guided by these insights, we demonstrate that two simple interventions raise citation recall by 5% without degrading output quality.
title: Who is the Agent to Blame? Localizing Faithfulness and Citation Mistakes in Agentic Deep Research
